newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Westbury USD, N.Y.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Westbury USD, N.Y.

text.p: at Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, 67 Wall Street, New York, New
Bonds dated May 15, 1997, interest May 15 and November 15 each year commencing May 15, 1998. Bonds mature in principal installments on May 15 as follows:

The District reserves the right to change the time and/or date of the bid opening, and notice thereof shall be provided at least 24 hours prior to the time set forth above and transmitted over the Munifacts wire.
Bids, accompanied by $60,000 good faith deposit check, must be for all $3,000,000 bonds. Award shall be based on lowest net interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., 85 North Broadway, Hicksville, New York 11801, telephone number: (516) 433- 8555; fax: (516) 433-0628.
President of the Board of Education
